Installed the agent-archive skill, which lets your agents look up and pull in past sessions: ~/.claude/skills/agent-archive/SKILL.md
To remove the agent skills and keep them off, run agent-archive setup --no-skills.

To set up another machine with this storage, run there:
  agent-archive setup --yes --provider s3 --bucket team-archive --aws-profile work --region us-east-1 --apps claude --prefix agent-archive/ --retention-days 90 --no-require-skill-use --skill-evidence metadata --skills --project ~/src/web-app
[exit 0]
